mutations.expect: off-by-one in the queue's pop bound: Rollup._popL1Messages pops in chunks of 256, so a batch that finalizes 256 or more L1 messages can never be finalized (finalizeBatch reverts in popCrossDomainMessage). No M3 law over the queue reads popCrossDomainMessage's guard; the obstruction belongs to the Rollup->queue link. Expected: missed.

off-by-one in the enqueue clock write: at block.timestamp 1 the queue stores the sentinel 0, so getFirstUnfinalizedMessageEnqueueTime reports no pending message and the Rollup's l1msg-delay check is defeated. Expected: the two PROVED member sentinel laws at line 377 move (PROVED -> REFUTED or UNKNOWN).

wrong store offset of totalL1MessagePopped in the Solidity header encoder (the getter still reads offset 17; storeDataHash then overwrites byte 25). Expected: the PROVED round trip enc_sol -> BatchHeaderBytes.TotalL1MessagePopped (v0) and the PROVED pinned cross-component codec law (v0) move to REFUTED.

off-by-one in the Go getter BatchHeaderBytes.TotalL1MessagePopped (reads bytes 18..25 instead of 17..24). Expected: the PROVED Go round trip (v0) and the PROVED Solidity-to-Go round trip (v1) move to REFUTED.

missing clear in revertBatch: a reverted batch keeps its committed hash, so it can never be recommitted ('batch already committed') and finalizeBatch accepts the reverted header. Expected: committedBatches becomes an UNDO residue of revertBatch (a residue law is added, or an UNDO law moves).

swapped cursor in revertBatch: the revert rewinds lastFinalizedBatchIndex instead of lastCommittedBatchIndex, so the reverted batches stay the commit tip and the finalized cursor moves backwards. Expected: revertBatch's write set changes, so the UNDO pairs and residues of revertBatch are re-derived (a law added, dropped or restated).
